title: stateIn, shareIn, Lifecycle, and Flow Tests Check

questions.prompt: Why might a WhileSubscribed stateIn test stay at its initial value?
questions.explanation: The start strategy activates upstream only while at least one subscriber exists.
options: The value is always cached on disk

questions.prompt: shareIn automatically materialises every upstream exception to subscribers.
questions.explanation: Upstream failure terminates the sharing coroutine unless handled before sharing.

questions.prompt: What owns the sharing coroutine lifetime?
questions.answer: The scope passed to stateIn or shareIn
questions.explanation: Cancellation of that scope stops the shared upstream job.
